newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: S&P puts Sampoerna on negative watch.
newsitem.headline: S&P puts Sampoerna on negative watch.

text.p: Standard and Poor's Corp said on Tuesday it has placed its BBB-plus corporate credit rating of PT Hanjaya Mandala Sampoerna on creditwatch with negative implications.
S&P said it had also put the BBB rating on the US$-denominated guaranteed notes issued by Sampoerna's subsidiary Sampoerna International Finance Co B.V. on creditwatch with negative implications.
S&P said the rating action follows an announcement by Sampoerna of a 2.85 percent equity investment in Indonesian motor vehicle manufacturer PT Astra International.

"While the magnitude of the investment is not at this point material, Standard & Poor's considers the investment to be outside the expected expansion parameters of kretek manufacturer Sampoerna, and could lead to heightened credit risk," S&P said.

"Although the objective of the investment is unclear, the combination of exposure to a variety of higher risk industries, leveraged in their own right and the ultimate size of investment and degree of influence, could lead to a rating downgrade."

S&P said it would seek to clarify Sampoerna's objectives on the level of its investment in Astra, its funding options for the investment, and, should Sampoerna gain management input, its plans for Astra's diverse range of business interests.
